verdict.rationale: Together AI documents an asynchronous Batch API for running bulk inference workloads at up to 50% lower cost, and offers GPU clusters for large batch jobs. That covers bulk processing of many inference requests at once. The evidence is a single overview line, with no detail on how batches are submitted, tracked, or retrieved. Nothing shows bulk operations over other resources such as files, models, endpoints, or fine-tuning jobs. Missing for 10: batch job submission/status/result-retrieval details, limits and input formats, bulk management operations beyond inference, independent or hands-on corroboration.
